transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you, doctor. Well... I suppose what brings me in is that I just keep thinking my wife and the kids would be better off if I didn't wake up. Lately, I've just been saying that I really don't need to see another winter.
Have you made a specific plan to end your life?

No, I don't have a specific plan. Like I just said, it's more of a... a feeling that my wife and kids would just be better off if I didn't wake up tomorrow. I haven't figured out a way to actually do it myself. I've just been telling them I don't need to be around for another winter.
Have you ever had a distinct period when your mood was unusually elevated or irritable compared with your usual self?
No... no, I can't say that I have. I've never really had a time where I felt unusually high or overly energetic, or anything like that. It's really just been... well, just feeling low. So, no.
Before this current period, have you ever had a similar period of feeling persistently depressed or hopeless?
No, I don't think so. I've had my ups and downs over the years, like anyone else, but... nothing like this. This is the first time it's been this bad, where it just doesn't lift.
How long have you been feeling persistently depressed or hopeless this time?
Well, this has been going on since my bowling partner died. That was... about a year and a month ago now.
Do you find yourself persistently yearning for or preoccupied with your bowling partner who died?

No, I wouldn't say that. I mean... I miss him, sure. We knew each other a long time. But I don't sit around yearning for him or thinking about him all day. It's not really about him specifically anymore... it's just this heavy feeling that started back then and just won't go away.
During this period, have you lost interest in or stopped enjoying things that you usually enjoy?

Yes, I have. I used to look forward to a lot of things... playing bridge, working out in the garden, helping with the church cooking, and going to Cubs games. But now... I mostly just sit in my chair. I just can’t seem to make myself care about any of it anymore.
How has your sleep been during this period?
My sleep? Well... it's been fine, really. I haven't noticed any changes with it. I just go to bed at my usual time and wake up like normal. I don't really have any trouble in that department.
During this period, how has your energy level been?

My energy? Well, I wouldn't say I've noticed any big changes there either. I mean, I don't feel particularly energetic, but I don't feel completely drained all the time either. It's just... normal, I guess. I just don't have the desire to use it for anything.
During this period, have you been feeling excessively guilty or worthless?

Yes, I have. I... well, I just keep going over every little thing I did wrong with him, and with my family. It just plays on a loop in my head. I really feel like I’m no good to anybody anymore, and honestly... I feel like I deserve whatever punishment is coming to me.
During this period, have you had difficulty concentrating or making decisions?

Yes, I really have. It's... well, I used to help out with the budgets down at the senior center, but I just can't keep the numbers straight anymore. I can't focus on it. And even just sitting at home, I'll stare at a bill, or look at my calendar for half an hour, and I just don't understand what I'm supposed to do. My mind just kind of goes blank.
During this period, have other people noticed that you are moving or speaking much more slowly than usual, or the opposite—that you seem unusually restless or unable to sit still?

Yes, my wife has pointed that out. She says I move like I’m walking through deep snow. And... well, it's true. Even just getting dressed in the morning or walking across the kitchen takes me so long now. Most of the time, I just end up giving up before I’ve really done much of anything.
